decisions.selected: Attain a developer discussion containing the workflow's nine mandated report sections for the requested commit range.
decisions.rationale: The adoption workflow explicitly requires a comprehensive report and names each required section; creation alone does not demonstrate the requested deliverable.

decisions.selected: The commit URL supplied to workflow_dispatch.
alternatives: The workflow run itself as the opportunity.
decisions.rationale: The input defines the requested change range, while a run is only the subject that serves it.

decisions.selected: Use the supplied base commit; for null case and event, reconstruct the closest eligible post-run discussion title and resolve its short SHA.
alternatives: Use run ID as the opportunity key.
Treat historical null assignment as zero.
decisions.rationale: The commit is the stable requested subject. The historical fallback preserves assignment when the original input is unavailable without converting unavailable evidence into failure.

decisions.selected: Same-repository development discussion title, timestamp, resolved base commit, and all nine required section headings.
decisions.rationale: Discussion content is the declared repository outcome; evals, activity, and output counts do not establish attainment of the requested report contract.

decisions.selected: Seven days after run creation with evidence cutoff capped at maturity.
decisions.rationale: The report is expected immediately, but the stable cap provides a fixed historical horizon for replay and late evidence.

decisions.selected: Binary direct attainment: complete required report contract is 1, incomplete is 0, unavailable is null.
decisions.rationale: The workflow specifies required sections but not a deterministic semantic similarity or file-coverage threshold; a binary contract avoids proxy scoring.
The workflow was first introduced at the adoption commit and no pre-adoption run contract or comparable frozen report series exists; unrelated manual discussions would not be comparable evidence.

decisions.selected: Expose report-contract completeness as a separate boolean-normalized diagnostic.
decisions.rationale: The diagnostic mirrors the accepted evidence and remains separate from the single authoritative value.

uncertainties.description: Historical runs with null case and event require matching a post-run discussion title to reconstruct the requested base commit.
uncertainties.mitigation: Use a deterministic timestamp window, exact title prefix, resolved commit SHA, and preserve repeated opportunity keys.

uncertainties.description: GitHub discussion history or commit resolution can be unavailable to the evaluator.
uncertainties.mitigation: Return null rather than zero and declare discussions:read explicitly.

uncertainties.description: Required headings demonstrate the declared report contract but cannot prove semantic correctness of every statement.
uncertainties.mitigation: Keep the metric limited to the explicit workflow contract and do not use agent judgment or activity proxies.
